contradicting_quotes.quote: Market data note, VIX equity volatility index (points): from the close before the CPI release on 2022-08-10 (08:30 ET) to the latest value published by the decision time (2022-08-31), the series rose by +4.10 (+0.5 standard deviations relative to changes of the same length over the previous 36 months).

assessments.explanation: VIX rose by 4.10 points after CPI release, indicating market stress which contradicts the link where market stress leads to higher equity prices (SPY).
